content: Refined blog article heading hierarchy: added numbered h2 styling with a theme-color underline glow, restored the small accent marker for h3, and unified heading rendering across posts
Improved in-article link previews: fixed hover preview and hover animation issues in Mac Chrome, and repositioned the preview card so it no longer blocks link clicks

Optimized homepage mobile scrolling performance: layout measurements dropped by about 63%, style calculations dropped by about 66%, mobile scroll sampling holds p95 around 16.8ms, and no long tasks were observed
Updated the type system: English headings now use Montserrat, while Chinese text uses Alibaba PuHuiTi
Reworked the homepage blog showcase: removed scroll-progress coupling and per-frame measurements, switched to a passive auto-scrolling rail, and added a scroll-speed control
Adjusted the homepage opening rhythm: the hero and blog showcase now snap as 100vh sections, while scrolling returns to normal for the longer sections after the third screen
Added vertical cut-reveal motion to the homepage hero title and copy, with refined text hierarchy and opacity
Fixed the third-screen travel widget sequence: the heading stays visible while the LED footprint map, life clock, and interactive map appear in order
Enhanced code block styling for better readability
Optimized comment loading logic to reduce user wait time
Added font opacity levels to enhance hierarchy and highlight key information
Fixed the sticky logic of blog overview page widgets to ensure correct display during scrolling
Enhanced the design of our cc copyright page
Improved the styling of our blog pagination component
Enhanced the TOC sidebar
Fixed movie page display logic
Adjusted dark mode colors for a more comfortable reading experience (previously too cold and unappealing)
Added homepage cover image for blog page, optimized motto display, and enriched page content.
Polished RSS feeds view with back-to-home and bilingual toggle
Enabled article TOC visibility on mobile
Added scroll-to-top progress button
Updated timeline logic
Added blog homepage cover image and surfaced it in the overview list
Simplified blog overview cards by reorganizing the information layout
